title: Ground a style study in inspected frames
statement: Base a reference video's style analysis on timestamped frames actually inspected, with observation kept apart from inference; with few frames narrow the claims, and with none build nothing style-specific.
example: The plan's research gate passes only when actual reference frames cover at least three motifs with timestamps.
detail: A plan to build reusable teaching-video modules in the style of a third-party reference video makes its first research step done only when a timestamped breakdown cites observed storyboard frames and keeps observation apart from inference. Its research gate passes when actual frames cover at least three motifs with timestamps, narrows the claims to the motifs observed when there are fewer frames, and stops the style-specific prototype when there is no visual evidence. If the reference cannot be inspected, the plan retrieves storyboard frames, uses only verified ones, and otherwise states the uncertainty and stops the style-specific work.
against: Planned, never run: the plan opens 'Plan-only phase: do not execute the prototype until the reference, existing kit, and renderer choices are checked.' (unit-video-kit-essay/docs/ESSAY-MODULES-PLAN.md, line 3). It is an untracked file, and none of the other five files it lists exists, so no breakdown, frame count or gate result is on record.

evidence.quote: Done when: a timestamped reference breakdown cites observed storyboard frames, and distinguishes observation from inference.
Actual reference frames cover at least three motifs with timestamps | Fewer frames: narrow claims to observed motifs | No visual evidence: stop style-specific prototype
Detect: no frame/timestamp evidence. Recover: (1) retrieve YouTube storyboard frames; (2) use only verified frames; (3) state uncertainty and stop style-specific implementation if still unavailable.
Plan-only phase: do not execute the prototype until the reference, existing kit, and renderer choices are checked.
